review:
A new hero in the Hunter universe, on 10 lines in an ancient Aztec city with a great atmospheric soundtrack.

Three tomb scatters give 10 free spins, where each premium symbol pays an instant cash prize whenever a collector is on screen, and a progress meter unlocks more rewards as you collect them. 96.02% RTP, a little lower than most of the series.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
